Class NativeDataBuffer

java.lang.Object
java.awt.image.DataBuffer
icyllis.arc3d.core.image.NativeDataBuffer
public class NativeDataBuffer extends DataBuffer
Wraps an off-heap address for Java2D interop.

Note: not all Java2D methods are compatible with a custom DataBuffer, since they can cast to known subclass to steal the heap array. Therefore, this class should only be used where compatibility is known.

This class does not manage the memory, caller should ensure the address is valid while this object is reachable.
